'''Choka Chok''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Swokes Swokes/Legends|Swokes Swokes]], who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]] during the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. A member of one of the higher-ranking Swokes Swokes castes, Chok was a nephew of a [[Unidentified Swokes Swokes caliph|caliph]] from the [[Congress of Caliphs]], Makem Te's planetary government. In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], Chok visited a [[Unidentified Makem Te restaurant|restaurant]] on Makem Te, and while there, he inadvertently knocked into the [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Toro Irana]]. Driven into a state of rage as a result of his consumption of the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Tempest (spice)|Tempest]], Irana demanded that the Swokes Swokes watch where he was going, and Chok proceeded to engage in a fight with the Jedi. Irana used his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to cut off Chok's [[Limb/Legends|forearm]], then beheaded the Swokes Swokes. The Jedi subsequently [[Death/Legends|slew]] several more of the restaurant's patrons, before jumping from a window and falling to his death. In the aftermath of the attack, the restaurant was closed for a period of mourning, to commemorate Chok's demise. The Congress of Caliphs made an official complaint to the New Republic regarding the [[New Jedi Order]]'s role in Chok's death, and the [[Jedi archivist/Legends|Jedi archivist]] [[Mander Zuma]] was dispatched by the Order to investigate why his apprentice had engaged in the rampage that had claimed Chok's life.
